verses.text: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, ‘This is what Yahweh, Israel’s God, says: “Let my people go, so they can hold a feast for me in the wilderness.”’ 📣
Pharaoh replied, ‘Who is Yahweh that I should listen to him and let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and I’m not letting Israel go.’ 👑
They said, ‘The Hebrews’ God met with us. Please let us travel three days into the wilderness and offer a sacrifice to Yahweh our God. Otherwise, he may strike us with disease or the sword.’ 🙏
Egypt’s king said, ‘Moses and Aaron, why are you pulling the people away from their work? Get back to your jobs!’ 😠
Pharaoh added, ‘There are already a lot of people in the land, and now you’re making them stop working.’ 🗣️
That same day, Pharaoh gave orders to the taskmasters and Israel’s foremen: 📣
‘Stop giving the people straw for making bricks like before. Make them go find straw for themselves. 🌾
‘But still demand the same number of bricks from them. Don’t cut their quota at all. They’re lazy—that’s why they’re saying, “Let us go offer sacrifices to our God.” 🧱
‘Pile more work on them so they stay busy. Don’t let them listen to lies.’ ⚠️
The taskmasters and foremen went out and told the people, ‘This is Pharaoh’s order: “I won’t give you straw. 📣
‘“Go find straw wherever you can, but your brick quota stays exactly the same.”’ 🌾
So the people spread all across Egypt, gathering stalks and scraps to use as straw. 🏃
The taskmasters kept rushing them: ‘Meet your daily quota, just like when you had straw!’ ⏱️
Pharaoh’s taskmasters beat Israel’s foremen and demanded, ‘Why didn’t you meet your brick quota yesterday or today like before?’ ⚠️
Then Israel’s foremen went to Pharaoh and pleaded, ‘Why are you treating your servants like this? 😟
‘You don’t give us straw, but they tell us, “Make bricks!” Look, we’re getting beaten, even though your own people are at fault.’ 💔
Pharaoh said, ‘You’re lazy—lazy! That’s why you keep saying, “Let us go offer sacrifices to Yahweh.”’ 😠
‘Now get back to work! You won’t get straw, but you still have to make the same number of bricks.’ 🧱
Israel’s foremen realized they were in serious trouble when they heard, ‘You can’t reduce the daily brick quota at all.’ 😰
They met Moses and Aaron, who were waiting along the road as they came from Pharaoh’s palace. 🚶
They said, ‘May Yahweh look at what you’ve done and judge you! You’ve made us stink in Pharaoh’s eyes and his officials’ eyes, and handed them an excuse to kill us!’ 😡
Moses went back to Yahweh and said, ‘Lord, why have you brought trouble on these people? Why did you send me? 🙏
‘Ever since I went to Pharaoh speaking in your name, he’s made things worse for them. You haven’t rescued your people at all!’ 😔
